scripts.title: Mlg Particles Update
scripts.script:
--Script Made By Exploiterz--
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local particleIds = {
    "rbxassetid://138730294568829",
    "rbxassetid://129255573879710",
    "rbxassetid://120361240510544",
    "rbxassetid://78586424030211",
    "rbxassetid://120258286380268",
    "rbxassetid://120790075888420",
    "rbxassetid://87505293556037"
}

local function createParticleEmitter(parent)
    for _, assetId in ipairs(particleIds) do
        local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        particle.Texture = assetId
        particle.Parent = parent
        particle.Enabled = true
        particle.Rate = 50
        particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(999999, 999999)
        particle.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
        particle.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
        particle.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
        particle.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        particle.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10, 1.5, 1.5)
    end
end

local function addParticlesToCharacter(character)
    if character then
        local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if humanoidRootPart then
            createParticleEmitter(humanoidRootPart)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        addParticlesToCharacter(character)
    end)
    if player.Character then
        addParticlesToCharacter(player.Character)
    end
end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player.Character then
        addParticlesToCharacter(player.Character)
    end
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        addParticlesToCharacter(character)
    end)
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    addParticlesToCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    addParticlesToCharacter(character)
end)

scripts.title: toggleable kill all
scripts.script:
local Toggle = false
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")


UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Z then
        Toggle = not Toggle
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Toggle then
        for _,v in workspace.Zombies:GetChildren() do
            if v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                game:GetService("Lighting").ETC:FireServer({v.Humanoid,math.huge,"Damage\240\159\144\153",false,false,false,[8] = vector.create(0,0,0),[9] = {HitS = 1,ConfirmedHit = 1}})
            end
        end
    end
end)
